title: Claude automates job applications and portfolio building #claudeai #jobautomation #creativejobs
description: Claude transformed the job application process by automating the search for relevant creative roles and crafting tailored pitches. Integrated with Higgsfield MCP, it converts work and references into a polished, cohesive portfolio complete with visuals and a showreel, then builds a portfolio website to showcase the personal brand. This combined workflow eliminates weeks of manual job searching and repetitive resume tweaking by analyzing listings, scoring matches, and managing outreach efficiently. The process highlights how AI-driven tools can streamline creative career development and job placement by handling both content creation and application targeting. It sets a new standard for personalized, data-driven job hunting, especially in creative industries where presentation and fit matter most. #ClaudeAI #HiggsfieldMCP #JobApplicationAutomation #CreativePortfolio #AIinHiring #PortfolioWebsite #JobSearchAI #CreativeJobs #PersonalBranding #AutomatedOutreach #AICareerTools #JobMatchAI #VisualPortfolio #CreativeIndustryTech #AIJobHunting
